summary: POSCO Holdings filed a Form 6-K reporting an adjustment to the exchange price of its foreign currency-denominated exchangeable bonds issued September 1, 2021. The adjustment, effective August 25, 2026, follows a cash dividend, reducing the exchange price from KRW 419,025 to KRW 414,343 per share and increasing the number of shares available for exchange from 87,977 to 88,971. The adjustment is a routine mechanical re-pricing per bond conditions; no special situation is involved.
